content.comment_body: Apologies for interrupting, but how can a sensor be represented in this software for connection purposes?
You need to clearly describe what you want to achieve. The way you frame your questions is confusing. Also, note that the [product_name] does not have 'PLC buttons', it uses cursor keys.
Sorry, I just wanted to know if it's possible to simulate a sensor on the industrial programmable controller.
Please check the attached video for guidance.
Oh, it's the sensor simulation, thank you. However, it seems you can't connect analog and binary cables, and this one is an analog cable. Is there any solution?

Analog connections are represented by thick lines in the diagram, while digital ones are thin lines. These can't be connected to each other for clear reasons, right? I can't provide what you need right now, as your requirements are not clearly described.

Hello, I understand the difference between analog and digital connections, but is it completely impossible to link them? With my program, I can't see how to convert an analog sensor value into a digital value, which my logic requires. Thank you.
Please provide a concrete example of what you want to achieve. I can't guess your intentions without specifics.
I don’t have a specific example, I just have [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no].
Maybe this [url] can help. It explains how to configure block references in [product_name] [version_no].
Here's another helpful [url]: [product_name] Library – Functions for processing analog values and communication.

Thank you, but this information did not help. Let me clarify: The setup requires two sensors, one for temperature and one for speed. I need to select a desired temperature at a given speed, and once the temperature is reached, speed should automatically increase to a specified RPM (this is my main challenge). Manual adjustment is also needed, but that's already resolved thanks to your help. I must also be able to heat a resistor for the temperature sensor up to a specific temperature, but that's less complicated. Thank you again and sorry for any confusion.
I think I have found a solution. I will let you know if it works.
I succeeded by connecting the counter. Thank you very much!
Hello again. Do you know why on the adjustment panel my logic works, but on the theoretical panel it displays B27? I just removed and reattached a cable in the same spot. Thank you.
The 0N parameter of B003 references the value from B027. When a parameter is just a reference, the display shows the source, which in your case is B027. Did my previous links not help?
The first link was actually helpful after rereading, but I still can't make the data display rather than the source reference. Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is having trouble representing and simulating sensor inputs, especially analog sensors, within [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no]. There is confusion over the ability to process and convert analog sensor inputs to digital values for use in logic blocks, as well as difficulty finding effective documentation or tools to enable simulation and value conversion between analog and digital domains.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects to use the software to simulate sensor inputs and connect analog signals to digital logic blocks. They want to be able to convert analog sensor data for use in digital logic, configuring the programmatically required functions in [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no].
